competency_fulfillment.rationale: Subtraction is performed throughout and every key I checked is arithmetically right, including the tight 1830 take away 1744 leaving 86. The missing-part phrasing, where a total and one part are given, states subtraction in the part-whole language of the objective.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The clause about regrouping is honoured on both sides: 8413 minus 4110 needs no exchange in any column, whereas 9120 minus 1093 and 5609 minus 1839 both do, and one comparison situation asks how many more rather than how many are left.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The backward number-line stems instruct counting back by ones over enormous distances; one has the dot at 6398 moving backward 3715 numbers with the direction to just count back that many. No Grade 3 pupil can execute that, and it teaches a strategy that fails at the very sizes this node targets.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Bare differences, total-and-one-part statements, backward jumps, classmate error checks and a how-many-more comparison all appear, and the truth judgments split between a True and a False key rather than leaning one way.

competency_alignment.rationale: Difficulty tracks the borrowing demand and the width of the two numbers, which is the axis that belongs to this subtraction objective.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Most values sit properly in the thousands, but one sample asks the difference between 18 and 10 water bowls and another works from 152. A single-column take-away is far under the four-digit band this Grade 3 quarter is meant to establish, even though it is technically inside the stated bound.
